capabilities: Move notes to a folder defined by a template frontmatter property
Remove the folder property from the note after applying the template
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not organize your templates folder; it moves notes into a folder named by a template's frontmatter property.
extras: Warns that with this plugin enabled, 'Insert Template' always replaces the entire note instead of appending or merging like the core plugin does.
intentEvidence: This plugin replaces the "Insert Template" command from the Templates core plugin
problem: Obsidian's core Templates plugin only inserts template content into the current note and cannot file a new note into a destination folder.

relations.evidence: This plugin replaces the "Insert Template" command from the Templates core plugin

summary: Replaces the core Templates 'Insert Template' command so that notes are moved to a folder defined by a property in the template.
